description: List, add or delete DNS records on a domain bought through handoff. Types: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV. handoff keeps the records that make the domain work — the ownership TXT, the domain's A record and www — and refuses to change them; point the domain with domain_routing (an app or the tunnel) instead. Use this for everything else: mail (MX), verification TXT for other services, subdomains.

action.description: list the records, add one, or delete one by id

agent_id.description: The agent that owns the domain — you must control it

answer.description: add: the value — an IP for A/AAAA, a hostname for CNAME/MX, text for TXT, "weight port target" for SRV

host.description: add: "@" for the domain itself, or a name under it like "mail" or "_dmarc"

id.description: delete: the record id from list

priority.description: add: required for MX and SRV (lower is preferred)

name: domain_dns
title: Edit a bought domain's DNS
